description:
Plan: ../recursive-denotations-proposal.html. Stack of PRs on main: PR1 reproducers+signal, PR2 fz-tfn.62 narrow, PR3 fz-kdt.48, PR4 fz-kdt.177 kernel, PR5 fz-kdt.177 semantics.

PR1. fz.compiler2.return_type.defined and .widened are emitted (src/compiler2/world.rs ~3411/3414) with a JSONL projection (src/telemetry/jsonl.rs ~1343) but never appear in a --log-telemetry capture, nor do activation_analysis.defined and callsite.defined; the public allowlist (is_public_compiler2_trace_event) or the raw-value registration is the likely cause (same family as fz-uai). Find it, fix it, and give tools/distill-telemetry.exs a section: ReturnType revisions per activation (count, and whether widened), so fz-kdt.177's stated signal is observable from the stream. Test: jsonl_emits_return_type_revisions; the distiller on json_roundtrip prints Json.value/1 with 18.
title: Return-type revision events reach the telemetry stream and the distiller counts them
